cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Backward integrated in critical wiring-harness components — terminals, connectors, cables and moulded parts — manufactured in-house to lower procurement overhead, secure supply against external disruption, and enable in-line quality control. Principal raw materials are copper, brass and polymers plus connectors, terminals, cables, mouldings (incl. rubber) and electronic components (sensors, PCBs); sourced domestically (principally Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Haryana) and internationally (China, Switzerland, Germany). All suppliers are required to be IATF-certified. Company strategy also includes forward moves into power electronics/charging sub-systems (DC-DC converters, on-board chargers, BJB sub-systems) and expansion of EV battery-pack interconnect systems from a single- to a multi-customer model.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- 66.91% of FY2025 revenue from operations came from the 2W automotive sector and 12.50% from 3W, with wiring harnesses alone comprising 78.00% of FY2025 revenue - any downturn in 2W/3W demand or wiring-harness pricing/technology directly hits the business
- Top customer Bajaj Auto contributed 35.08% of FY2025 revenue (32.33% in 9M Dec-2025); top 5 customers contributed 71.18% of FY2025 revenue (72.49% in 9M Dec-2025) and top 10 customers 81.81% - loss of any major OEM relationship would be materially adverse
- Hosur (wiring harness) and Chakan, Pune (battery pack assembly) facilities are under construction with expected completion in Q2 and Q1 FY2027 respectively (per Risk Factors); company flags possible delays/cost overruns from regulatory approvals and construction delays
- 26 tax proceedings pending against the Company and 2 against Subsidiaries as of the UDRHP-I date, with aggregate amount involved of approx Rs.234 million (Company) and Rs.2.81 million (Subsidiaries); materiality threshold for civil litigation is Rs.136.09 million
- Company was unable to locate certain historical RoC records (Form 18/challan for a 2007 registered-office change) and relied on an independent search report; DRHP also flags an instance of certain non-compliances under the Companies Act in the past
- Net debt to EBITDA rose to 1.51x (9M Dec-2025) from 0.99x (FY2024), while net capex ran at 11.17% of revenue in FY2025, as the company funds new plants partly through debt
- BC Asia XV (Bain Capital) acquired a 49% stake in April 2025 (now 55% pre-Offer) and the Company completed a common-control acquisition of Dhoot Holdings Private Limited and downstream entities during 9M ended Dec-2025, requiring restatement of FY2023-FY2025 financials as if combined from April 1, 2022
